input.explanation: The ZeroDivisionError comes from average_spend_per_item_this_month in this repository, and the fix is entirely here. With it, shoppers who haven't bought anything this month get a monthly figure of 0 and the account page renders, whether monthly-spend-feature is on or off. Nothing outside this repository has to change: the flag can stay as it is, and the callers in account_page.py already handle the int this function returns.
